Nirodhavāra (The Chapter on Cessation)
3.2.2.1. Chapter on the Present (Paccuppannavāra) 3.2.2.1.1.
Positive Person (Anulomapuggala) For whom the eye-base ceases, does the ear-base cease for that person?
For those who possess the eye-faculty but lack the ear-faculty at the moment of death, the eye-base ceases,
but the ear-base does not cease. For those who possess both the eye-faculty and the ear-faculty at the moment of death, both the eye-base and the ear-base cease.
Or again, for whom the ear-base ceases, does the eye-base cease for that person?
For those who possess the ear-base but lack the eye-base at the moment of death, the ear-base ceases, but the eye-base does not cease for them.
For those who possess both the ear-base and the eye-base at the moment of death, both the ear-base and the eye-base cease.
Does the eye-base cease for that person for whom the nose-base ceases?
For those who are passing away possessing the eye-base but lacking the nose-base, the eye-base ceases, but the nose-base does not cease for them.
For those who are passing away possessing both the eye-base and the nose-base, the eye-base [ceases]...
Does the nose base cease, and does the eye base also cease?
Or conversely, for whom the nose base ceases, does the eye base also cease for them?
For those who are passing away while possessing the nose base but lacking the eye base, the nose base ceases for them, but the eye base does not cease for them.
It ceases. For those who are dying while possessing both the nose and the eye, the nose-base ceases and the eye-base also ceases.
Does the visible-object base cease for one in whom the eye-base ceases? Yes.
Or rather, for whom the visible-object base ceases, does the eye-base cease for them?
For those who possess the material body but lack the eye at the moment of death, the visible-object base ceases, but the eye-base does not cease for them.
For those who possess the eye at the moment of death, both the visible-object base and the eye-base cease.
Does the mind-base cease for one in whom the eye-base ceases? Yes.
Or rather, does the eye-base cease for one in whom the mind-base ceases?
For those who are passing away with a mind but without eyes, the mind-base ceases, but the eye-base does not cease for them.
It ceases. For those who possess eyes and are passing away, both the mind-base (*manāyatana*) and the eye-base (*cakkhāyatana*) cease.
Does the mental-object-base (*dhammāyatana*) cease for one in whom the eye-base ceases? Yes.
Or rather, does the eye-base cease for one in whom the mental-object-base ceases?
For those who are dying without eye-faculty, the base of mental phenomena ceases, but the eye-base does not cease for them.
For those who are dying with eye-faculty, both the base of mental phenomena and the eye-base cease. (Based on the eye-base.)
Does the base of odour cease for one for whom the base of visible form ceases? Yes.
Or rather, does the base of odour cease for one for whom the base of visible form ceases?
For those who possess the base of visible form but lack the base of odour at the moment of death, the base of visible form ceases, but the base of odour does not cease for them.
It ceases. For those passing away with the nose faculty, both the visible-object base and the nose base cease.
Does the mind base cease for one for whom the nose base ceases? Yes.
Or rather, does the nose base cease for one for whom the mind base ceases?
For those who possess mind but lack a nose and are passing away, the mind-base ceases, but the nose-base does not cease for them.
For those who possess a nose and are passing away, both the mind-base and the nose-base cease.
Does the cognizable-base cease for one for whom the nose-base ceases? Yes.
Or, for whom the base of mental phenomena (*dhammāyatana*) ceases, does the base of the nose (*ghānāyatana*) cease for them?
For those who are passing away without a nose, the base of mental phenomena ceases, but the base of the nose does not cease for them.
For those who are passing away with a nose, both the base of mental phenomena and the base of the nose cease.
(Based on the sense-base of smell.
For whom the sense-base of visible form ceases, for them does the sense-base of mind cease?
For those who are passing away in a mindless state, the sense-base of visible form ceases, but for them the sense-base of mind does not cease.
For those who are passing away with form and with mind, both the visible-object base (*rūpāyatana*) ceases and the mind base (*manāyatana*) ceases.
Or rather, for whom the mind base ceases, does the visible-object base cease for them?

For those who are passing away without form, the mind base ceases, but the visible-object base does not cease for them. For those who are passing away with form and with mind, both the mind base ceases and the visible-object base ceases.
Does the base of mental phenomena cease for that person for whom the base of visible forms ceases? Yes.
Or rather, does the base of visible forms cease for that person for whom the base of mental phenomena ceases?

For those passing away who are non-material, the base of mental phenomena ceases, but the base of visible forms does not cease for them. For those passing away who possess material form, both the base of mental phenomena and the base of visible forms cease.
For whom the mind-base ceases, for them does the mental-object-base cease? Yes.
Or rather, for whom the mental-object-base ceases, for them does the mind-base cease?

For those passing away who are without consciousness, the mental-object-base ceases, but the mind-base does not cease for them. For those passing away who possess consciousness, both the mental-object-base and the mind-base cease.
3.2.2.1.2. Positive Plane (Anuloma-okāsa):
Where the eye-base ceases … [as above] … (In respect of arising, in respect of cessation, and in respect of both arising and cessation, the application is identical in all instances.
3.2.2.1.3. Positive Person and Plane (Anuloma-puggalokāsa)
For whom, where the eye-base ceases, does the ear-base cease there?
… [and so on] … the nose-base … the visible-object-base … the mind-base … does the mental-phenomena-base cease there?
(The "for whom, where" formula should also be expanded in the same way.)
3.2.2.1.4. Negative Person (Paccanīka-puggala) For whom the eye-base does not cease, for that person does the ear-base not cease?
For those who are without the eye-base but possessing the ear-base at the moment of death, the eye-base does not cease, but it is not the case that the ear-base does not cease for them.
The ear base does not cease. For all those who are being reborn, and for those who are dying without eye or ear, neither the eye base nor the ear base ceases.
Or else, for whom the ear base does not cease, does the eye base not cease for them?
For those who are without the ear-base but possess the eye-base at the moment of death, the ear-base does not cease,

yet it is not the case that the eye-base does not cease for them. For all those being reborn, and for those who are without the ear-base and without the eye-base at the moment of death, neither the ear-base nor the eye-base ceases.
For whom the eye-base does not cease, for them the nose-base does not cease?
For those who are without eyes but possess a nose and are passing away, the eye-base does not cease, yet the nose-base does not fail to cease for them.
For all those being reborn, and for those who are without eyes and without a nose and are passing away [the same applies].
For them, neither the eye-base nor the nose-base ceases. Or rather: for whom the nose-base does not cease, does the eye-base not cease for them?
For those who are without a nose but possess eyes at the moment of death, the nose-base does not cease, yet it is not that the eye-base does not cease for them.

The eye-base does not cease. For all those being reborn, for those who are without nose-faculty, and for those who are without eye-faculty at the moment of death, neither the nose-base nor the eye-base ceases.
For one in whom the eye-base does not cease, does the visible-object-base not cease?
For those who are eyeless but possess visible forms at the moment of death, the eye-base does not cease,
yet the visible-form base does not fail to cease for them. For all those being reborn and for those who are formless at the moment of death,
neither the eye-base nor the visible-form base ceases.
Or again, for whom visible-object base does not cease, for that person does eye-base not cease? Yes.
For whom eye-base does not cease, for that person does mind-base not cease?
For those who are without eyes but possess consciousness at the moment of death, eye-base does not cease, but it is not the case that mind-base does not cease for them.
The mind-base does not cease. For all those being reborn and for those passing away who are without consciousness, neither the eye-base nor the mind-base ceases.
Or conversely, for whom the mind-base does not cease, does the eye-base not cease for them? Yes.
For whom the eye-base does not cease, for them the mental-object-base does not cease?
For those who are passing away without the eye, the eye-base does not cease, but it is not the case that the mental-object-base does not cease for them.
For all those who are being reborn, neither the eye-base nor the mental-object-base ceases.

Or rather: For whom the base of mental phenomena (*dhammāyatana*) does not cease, for that person does the base of the eye (*cakkhāyatana*) not cease? Yes. (End of the section based on the base of the eye.
For whom the base of the nose (*ghānāyatana*) does not cease, for that person does the base of visible form (*rūpāyatana*) not cease?
For those who are without a nose but possess visible forms at the moment of death, the base of the nose does not cease, but it is not the case that the base of visible form does not cease for them.
The visible-object base does not cease. For all those who are being reborn and for those non-percipient beings passing away, neither the nose base nor the visible-object base ceases.
Or conversely, for whom the visible-object base does not cease, does the nose base not cease for them? Yes.
For whom the nose-base does not cease, for them the mind-base does not cease?
For those who are without nose-faculty but possess mind and are passing away, the nose-base does not cease, but it is not the case that the mind-base does not cease for them.
For all those being reborn and for those who are mindless at the moment of death, both the nose-base and [the mind-base]...
Does the mind-base not cease, and the nose-base also not cease?
Or conversely, for whom the mind-base does not cease, does the nose-base not cease for them? Yes.
For whom the nose-base does not cease, does the mental-object-base not cease for them?
For those who are passing away among those devoid of the nose, the nose-base does not cease, yet the mental-object-base does not fail to cease for them.
For all those who are being reborn, neither the nose-base nor the mental-object-base ceases.
Or, conversely, for whomsoever the mental-object-base does not cease, does the nose-base not cease for them? Yes, it does. (The section based on the nose-base.)
For whom the visible-object base does not cease, for that person does the mind base not cease?

For those passing away from the formless realm, the visible-object base does not cease, but it is not the case that the mind base does not cease for them. For all those being reborn, neither the visible-object base nor the mind base ceases.
Or conversely, for whom the mind base does not cease, for that person does the visible-object base not cease?
For those passing away while without consciousness, the mind-base does not cease, yet the visible-object-base does not fail to cease for them.
For all those being reborn, neither the mind-base nor the visible-object-base ceases.
Does the mental-object-base not cease for one for whom the visible-object-base does not cease?

For those passing away from the formless realms (*arūpakānaṃ cavantānaṃ*), the base of visible forms (*rūpāyatanaṃ*) does not cease, but it is not the case that the base of mental phenomena (*dhammāyatanaṃ*) does not cease for them.
For all those being reborn (*sabbesaṃ upapajjantānaṃ*), neither the base of visible forms nor the base of mental phenomena ceases.
Or rather, for whomsoever the base of mental phenomena does not cease, does the base of visible forms not cease for them? Yes, it does. (End of the section based on the base of visible forms.)
Does the base of mental phenomena (dhammāyatana) not cease for one in whom the base of mind (manāyatana) does not cease?
For those passing away while mindless, the base of mind does not cease, but the base of mental phenomena does not fail to cease for them.
For all those being reborn, neither the base of mind nor the base of mental phenomena ceases.
Or, for whom the base of mental phenomena does not cease, does the base of mind not cease for them? Yes.
3.2.2.1.5. Negative Spatial Analysis:
Where the base of the eye does not cease … [and so on] … pe … .
3.2.2.1.6. Negative Person-Space (Paccanīka-Puggalokāsa) For whom, where the eye-base does not cease, for that person there the ear-base does not cease?
…pe… (The "for whom, where" [formula] is identical to the "for whom" [formula].)
3.2.2.2. The Past Section (Atītavāra) 3.2.2.2.1.
Positive Person (Anulomapuggala) For whom the eye-base had ceased, had the ear-base ceased for them?
Yes. (In the section on arising, the section on cessation, and the section on both arising and cessation, past questions—whether in direct or inverse order—are similar. 3.2.2.3.
Future Section 3.2.2.3.1. Direct Order:
Person (Anuloma-puggala)
For whom the eye-base will cease, for that person will the ear-base cease? Yes.
Or rather, for whom the ear-base will cease, for that person will the eye-base cease? Yes.
For whom the eye-base will cease, for that person will the nose-base cease?

For those destined for their final existence who are being reborn in the fine-material sphere, and for those who, having been reborn in the fine-material sphere, will attain final Nibbāna at the moment of death,
the eye-base will cease, but the nose-base will not cease for them. For others, both the eye-base and the nose-base will cease.
Or, for whomsoever the nose-base will cease, will the eye-base cease for that person? Yes.
For whomsoever the eye-base will cease, will the visible-object-base cease for that person? Yes.
Or, for whomsoever the visible-object-base will cease, will the eye-base cease for that person? Yes.
For whom the eye-base will cease, for that person will the mind-base …pe… the mental-object-base cease? Yes.
Or rather, for whom the mental-object-base will cease, for that person will the eye-base cease?
For those undergoing final existence in the formless realm who are being reborn there, and for those who, having been reborn in the formless realm, will attain final nibbāna.
For those who are passing away, the base of mental phenomena (*dhammāyatana*) will cease, but the eye-base (*cakkhāyatana*) will not cease for them.
For others, both the base of mental phenomena and the eye-base will cease. (End of the section based on the eye-base.
Will the visible-object-base (*rūpāyatana*) cease for one for whom the nose-base (*ghānāyatana*) will cease? Yes.
Or again, for whom the visible base will cease, will the nose base cease for them?

For those at the moment of rebirth in the fine-material sphere who are destined for their final existence there, and for those who, having been reborn in the fine-material sphere, will attain final nibbāna while passing away from there—
the visible base will cease for them, but the nose base will not cease for them.
In other persons, both the visible-object base will cease and the nose-base will cease.
For whom the nose-base will cease, will the mind-base …pe… the mental-object base cease for them? Yes.
Or else, for whom the mental-object base will cease, will the nose-base cease for them?
For those final-existence beings reborn in the fine-material sphere or the immaterial sphere, and for those who, having been reborn in the fine-material or immaterial sphere,
will attain final Nibbāna there at the moment of death, the base of mental phenomena (dhammāyatana) will cease,
but the base of the nose (ghānāyatana) will not cease for them. For others, both the base of mental phenomena and [the base of the nose] will cease.
And the nose-base will cease. (Based on the nose-base.
For whom the visible-form base will cease, for that person will the mind-base … pe … the mental-object base cease? Yes.
Or conversely, for whom the mental-object base will cease, for that person will the visible-form base cease?
For those destined for their final existence who are reborn in the formless realm, and for those who, having been reborn in the formless realm, will attain final nibbāna at the moment of death,

the base of mental phenomena (dhammāyatana) will cease, but the base of visible forms (rūpāyatana) will not cease for them. For others, both the base of mental phenomena and the base of visible forms will cease.
For whom the mind-base (manāyatana) will cease, for that person will the mental-object-base (dhammāyatana) cease? Yes.
Or rather, for whom the mental-object-base will cease, for that person will the mind-base cease? Yes.
3.2.2.3.2. Positive Plane (Anuloma-okāsa).
Where the eye-base will cease ... [etc. ...
3.2.2.3.3. Positive Person-Space (Anuloma-Puggalokāsa):
For whom, where the eye-base will cease, will the ear-base also cease there? Yes.
Or again, for whom and where … [as before] …? Yes.
For whom and where the eye-base will cease, for that person there the nose-base will cease?
For those in the fine-material sphere … [as before] … for those in the sense-sphere … [as before].
Or, for whom and where... [as before] ...? Yes.
For whom and where the eye-base will cease, for that person there the visible-object-base will cease? Yes.
Or, for whom and where the visible-object-base will cease, for that person there the eye-base will cease?
[This applies to] non-percipient beings … [and] to those of the five-aggregate realm …pe….
For whom, where the eye-base will cease, will the mind-base cease there for them? Yes.
Or conversely, for whom, where …pe…?
For those of the formless realm … pe … for those of the five-aggregate realm … pe ….
For whom, where the eye-base will cease, will the mental-object-base (dhammāyatana) cease there? Yes.
Or conversely, for whom, where … pe …?
[The same applies to] non-percipient beings, those in the formless realm …pe… and those in the five-aggregate realm …pe…. (Based on the eye-base.
For whom, where, will the nose-base cease, for that person there will the visible-object-base cease? Yes.
Or rather, for whom, where …pe…?
For those of the fine-material sphere … pe … for those of the sense-sphere … pe ….
For whom, where the nose-base will cease, will the mind-base cease there? Yes.
Or conversely, for whom, where … pe …?
Of those belonging to the fine-material sphere, those belonging to the immaterial sphere …pe… those belonging to the sense-sphere …pe….
For whom, where the nose-base will cease, will the mental-object-base cease there? Yes.
Or, for whom, where …pe…?
For those of the fine-material sphere, for those of the immaterial sphere …pe… for those of the sense-sphere …pe…. (Based on the base of odor.
For whom, where the visible-base will cease, will the mind-base cease there for them?
For non-percipient beings …pe… for those of the five-aggregate plane …pe….
Or for whom, and where... [etc.]?
For those in the formless realms... [etc. ...for those in the five-aggregate planes... [etc.
...For whom, and where, the base of visible forms will cease, for that person there the base of mental phenomena will also cease? Yes.

Or for whom, and where, [is it not so]? …pe… For those in the formless realms, …pe… for those in the fivefold sensual plane, and for non-percipient beings, …pe…. (Based on the sense-sphere of visible forms.
For whom, and where, is the sense-sphere of mind? …pe… Yes, it is.

Or for whom, where...? For non-percipient beings... [and] for those of the four-constituent and five-constituent realms, there the base of mental phenomena (*dhammāyatana*) will cease and the base of mind (*manāyatana*) will also cease.
(Just as in the section on arising, the future questions concerning "for whom" and "where" were explained in detail.)
In the same way, this should be expanded for cessation as well.
3.2.2.3.4. Negative Person:
For whom the eye-base will not cease, will the ear-base not cease for that person? Yes.
Or, for whom ear-base will not cease, will eye-base not cease for that person? Yes.
For whom eye-base will not cease, will nose-base not cease for that person? Yes.
Or, for whom nose-base will not cease, will eye-base not cease for that person?

For those final-existence beings (*pacchimabhavika*) being reborn in the fine-material sphere (*rūpāvacara*), and for those who, having been reborn in the fine-material sphere, will attain final nibbāna (*parinibbāyissanti*) at the moment of death, the nose-base (*ghānāyatana*) will not cease;
yet it is not the case that the eye-base (*cakkhāyatana*) will not cease for them.

[This is so] for those attaining final nibbāna in the five-aggregate realm (*pañcavokāra*), for final-existence beings in the immaterial sphere (*arūpa*), and for those [who have attained the fruit] in the immaterial sphere.
For those who will attain final nibbāna after being reborn, at the time of their death, neither the nose base nor the eye base will cease.
For whomsoever the eye base will not cease, will the visible-object base not cease for them? Yes.
Or again, for whom the visible base will not cease, for that person will the eye base not cease? Yes.
For whom the eye base will not cease, for that person will the mind base … pe … the mental-phenomena base not cease?
For those at the point of rebirth in the formless realm who are to have their final existence there, and for those who, having been reborn in the formless realm, will attain final Nibbāna there.
For those who are passing away, the eye-base will not cease, but it is not the case that for them the mind-object-base will not cease.
For those who are attaining final Nibbāna, neither the eye-base nor the mind-object-base will cease.
Or, conversely, for whomsoever the mind-object-base will not cease, will the eye-base not cease for them? Yes. (End of the section based on the eye-base.)
For whom the nose-base will not cease, for them the visible-object-base will not cease?
For those final-existence beings reborn in the fine-material sphere, and for those who, having been reborn in the fine-material sphere,
will attain final nibbāna at the moment of death— their nose-base will not cease, but it is not the case that their visible-object-base does not cease.
It will cease. For those attaining final nibbāna in the five-aggregate plane, for those in their final existence in the formless plane,
and for those who, having been reborn in the formless plane, will attain final nibbāna at the time of death— for these,
neither the nose base nor the visible-object base will cease.
Or, for whomsoever the visible-base will not cease, will the nose-base not cease for them? Yes.
For whomsoever the nose-base will not cease, will the mind-base …pe… the mental-object-base not cease for them?
For those attaining rebirth in the fine-material sphere or the immaterial sphere who are final-existence beings, and for others [attaining rebirth] in the fine-material or immaterial spheres—no.
For those who will attain final nibbāna after being reborn, at the moment of their death, the nose-base will not cease,
but the mental-object base will not fail to cease for them. For those attaining final nibbāna [in this very life],
neither the nose-base nor the mental-object base will cease.
Or rather, for whom the base of mental phenomena (dhammāyatana) will not cease, for that person will the base of the nose (ghānāyatana) not cease? Yes.
For whom the base of visible form (rūpāyatana) will not cease, for that person will the base of mind (manāyatana) …pe… the base of mental phenomena not cease?
For those in their final existence who are reborn in the formless realm, and for those who, having been reborn in the formless realm, will attain final nibbāna.
For those who are passing away, the sphere of visible form (rūpāyatana) will not cease, but it is not the case that the sphere of mental objects (dhammāyatana) will not cease for them.
For those who are attaining final Nibbāna (parinibbāna), neither the sphere of visible form nor the sphere of mental objects will cease.
Or, conversely, for whomsoever the sphere of mental objects will not cease, for him the sphere of visible form will not cease? Yes, it will.
For whom the mind-base (manāyatana) will not cease, for that person the mental-object-base (dhammāyatana) will not cease? Yes.
Or rather, for whom the mental-object-base will not cease, for that person the mind-base will not cease? Yes.
3.2.2.3.5. Negative Plane (Paccanīka-okāsa).
Where the eye-base will not cease … [as before] … 3.2.2.3.6.
Negative Person-Plane (Paccanīka-Puggalokāsa):
For whom the eye-base will not cease at a certain place, for that person will the ear-base not cease at that same place? Yes.
Or again, for whomsoever the ear-base will not cease at a certain place, will the eye-base not cease for that person at that place? Yes.
For whomsoever the eye-base will not cease at a certain place, will the nose-base not cease for that person at that place? Yes.
Or again, for whomsoever the nose-base will not cease at a certain place, will the eye-base not cease for that person at that place?
For those belonging to the fine-material sphere, the nose base will not cease there, but the eye base will not [necessarily] not cease there for them.
For those attaining final nibbāna in the five-aggregate plane, for non-percipient beings, and for those in the immaterial sphere,
neither the nose base nor the eye base will cease there.
For whom the eye-base will not cease at a certain place, for them the visible-object-base will not cease at that place?
For non-percipient beings, the eye-base will not cease there, but it is not the case that the visible-object-base will not cease for them there.
For those attaining final nibbāna in the five-aggregate plane and for those in the formless realm, the eye-base [will not cease] there...
[Is it the case that] the visible-object base will not cease and the eye-base will also not cease?
Or conversely, for whomsoever the visible-object base will not cease at a certain place, will the eye-base also not cease for them at that same place? Yes.
For whomsoever the eye-base will not cease at a certain place, will the mind-base also not cease for them at that same place?
For those immaterial beings, the eye-base will not cease there, but the mind-base will not fail to cease for them there. For those attaining final nibbāna and for non-percipient beings,
neither the eye-base nor the mind-base will cease there.
Or alternatively: For whomsoever the mind-base will not cease at a certain place, for that person the eye-base will not cease at that place? Yes.
For whomsoever the eye-base will not cease at a certain place, for that person the mental-object-base will not cease at that place?
For non-percipient beings and for those in the formless realm, the eye-base will not cease there, but it is not the case that the mental-object-base will not cease for them there.

In that case, the base of mental phenomena (*dhammāyatana*) will not cease. For those who are attaining final Nibbāna, neither the eye-base (*cakkhāyatana*) nor the base of mental phenomena will cease there. Or conversely:
for whomsoever the base of mental phenomena will not cease in a certain place, will the eye-base also not cease for them there? Yes, it will. (End of the section based on the eye-base.)
For whom the nose-base will not cease at a certain place, for them the visible-object-base will not cease at that place?
For those of the fine-material sphere, the nose-base will not cease there, but it is not the case that the visible-object-base will not cease for them there.
For those attaining final nibbāna in the five-aggregate plane and for those in the immaterial sphere, neither the nose-base nor [the visible-object-base] will cease there.
[It is] not that the visible-object base will cease, and the visible-object base will not cease.
Or rather: for whomsoever, wherever the visible-object base will not cease, for that person there, will the nose-base not cease? Yes.
For whomsoever, wherever the nose-base will not cease, for that person there, will the mind-base not cease?
For those in the fine-material sphere and the immaterial sphere, the nose base will not cease there;
yet it is not the case that the mind base will not cease for them there. For those attaining final nibbāna and for non-percipient beings, neither the nose base nor the mind base will cease there.
Or rather: For whomsoever the mind-base will not cease at a certain place, for that person the nose-base will not cease at that place? Yes.
For whomsoever the nose-base will not cease at a certain place, for that person the mental-object-base will not cease at that place?
For those of the fine-material sphere and the immaterial sphere, the nose-base will not cease at that place, but it is not the case that for them the mental-object-base [will not cease].

In that case, the base of mental phenomena (dhammāyatana) will not cease. For those attaining final Nibbāna, both the base of the nose (ghānāyatana) and the base of mental phenomena will not cease there. Or conversely:
for whomsoever the base of mental phenomena will not cease in a certain place, will the base of the nose also not cease for them in that same place?
Yes. (Based on the sense-base of the nose.

For whom the visible-object base will not cease at a certain place, for that person will the mind-base not cease at that place? For those non-percipient beings, the visible-object base will not cease there, but the mind-base will not [fail to] cease for them there either.
It will not cease. For those who are attaining final Nibbāna, neither the visible-object base nor the mind base will cease there.
Or else: for whomsoever the mind base will not cease there, will the visible-object base not cease there for them?
For non-percipient beings, the mind base will not cease there, but the visible-object base does not [necessarily] cease there for them.
It will not cease. For those attaining final Nibbāna, there the mind-base will not cease and the visible-form base will not cease.
For whomsoever the visible-form base will not cease at a certain place, for that person the mental-object base will not cease at that place?
For those non-percipient beings, the visible-form base will not cease there, but for them the mental-object base does not [fail to] cease there.
It will not cease. For those who are attaining final Nibbāna, neither the base of visible forms nor the base of mental phenomena will cease there.

Or conversely: for whomsoever the base of mental phenomena will not cease at a certain place, for that person will the base of visible forms not cease there? Yes. (End of the section based on the base of visible forms.
For whomsoever the base of mind will not cease at a certain place, for that person will the base of mental phenomena not cease there?
For non-percipient beings, the mind base will not cease there, but it is not the case that the mental-object base will not cease for them there.
For those attaining final Nibbāna, both the mind base and the mental-object base will not cease there. Or conversely:
for whomsoever the mental-object base will not cease in a certain place, will the mind base also not cease for them there? Yes.
3.2.2.4. Chapter on the Present and the Past (Paccuppannātītavāra) 3.2.2.4.1.
Positive Person (Anulomapuggala) For whom the eye-base ceases, for that person did the ear-base cease? Yes.
Or else, for whom the ear-base has ceased, does the eye-base cease for them?
For all those being reborn and for those passing away who are without eyes, the ear-base has ceased, but the eye-base does not cease for them.
For those passing away who possess eyes, both the ear-base and the eye-base have ceased.
The eye-base ceases.
For whom the eye-base ceases, does the nose-base … [and so on] … the visible-form base … [and so on] … the mind-base … [and so on] … the mental-object base cease for that person? Yes.
Or conversely, for whom the mental-object base has ceased, does the eye-base cease for that person?
For all those being reborn and for those passing away who are without the eye-base,

the base of mental phenomena has ceased, but the eye-base does not cease for them. For those passing away who possess the eye-base, both the base of mental phenomena has ceased and the eye-base ceases.
For whom the nose-base ceases, for that person does the visible-object-base cease … [and so on] … the mind-base cease … [and so on] … has the mental-object-base ceased? Yes.
Or else, for whom the mental-object-base has ceased, for that person does the nose-base cease?
For all those being reborn and for those dying who are not possessed of a nose, the mental-object-base has ceased.
And yet, the nose-base does not cease for them. For those who are passing away while possessing a nose, the mental-object base has ceased and the nose-base also ceases.
For whom the visible-form base ceases, does the mind-base … [and so on] … the mental-object base cease for them? Yes.
Or, for whomsoever the base of mental phenomena (dhammāyatana) had ceased, does the base of visible forms (rūpāyatana) cease for them?
For all those being reborn and for those of the formless realm passing away, the base of mental phenomena had ceased, but the base of visible forms does not cease for them.
For those with a physical body passing away, both the base of mental phenomena and the base of visible forms had ceased.
And the visible-object base ceases.
For whom the mind base ceases, for that person has the mental-object base ceased? Yes.
Or rather, for whom the mental-object base has ceased, for that person does the mind base cease?
For all those being reborn and for those mindless beings passing away, the base of mental phenomena (dhammāyatana) has ceased,
but the base of the mind (manāyatana) does not cease for them. For those with minds passing away, both the base of mental phenomena and the base of the mind have ceased.
3.2.2.4.2. Positive Section (Anuloma-okāsa):
Where the eye-base ceases … [etc. … 3.2.2.4.3.
Positive Section on Persons (Anuloma-puggalokāsa)
For whom and where the eye-base ceases, for them has the ear-base ceased there?
For those attaining final nibbāna in the Pure Abodes (suddhāvāsa), the eye-base ceases there, but the ear-base has not ceased there for them.
For others who are passing away while possessing the eye, both the eye-base and... [the ear-base cease there].
The ear-base ceases, and it has ceased.
Or else, for whomsoever the ear-base has ceased at a certain place, does the eye-base cease for that person at that same place?
For those being reborn in the five-aggregate realm and for those passing away from the sense-sphere who are without eyes, the ear-base [has ceased] there.
[It] had ceased, but the eye-base does not cease for them there. For those who are possessing the eye and are passing away, the ear-base had ceased and the eye-base also ceases there.
For whom the eye-base ceases there, had the nose-base ceased for them there?
For those passing away from the fine-material sphere, the eye-base ceases there,
but the nose-base has not ceased there for them. For those passing away from the sense-sphere who possess eyes, both the eye-base and the nose-base cease there for them.
Or again, for whomsoever the nose-base had ceased at a certain place, does the eye-base cease for them there?

For those who are being reborn in the sense-sphere without eyes, and for those passing away from the sense-sphere, the nose-base had ceased for them there, but the eye-base does not cease for them there. [However,] for those with eyes passing away from the sense-sphere...
For those who are passing away there, the nose-base has ceased and the eye-base is ceasing.
For whom the eye-base is ceasing there, has the visible-object-base ceased there for them?
For those who are attaining final Nibbāna in the Pure Abodes, the eye-base is ceasing there, but for them the visible-object-base has not [previously] ceased there.
The visible-object base had ceased for them. For those others who possess eyes and are passing away, does the eye-base cease and the visible-object base have ceased for them there?
Or conversely, for whomsoever the visible-object base has ceased there, does the eye-base cease for them there?
For those being reborn in the five-aggregate realm who are without eyes, for those passing away from the sense-sphere realm,

and for non-percipient beings— form-base has ceased for them there, but eye-base does not cease for them there. For those passing away who possess eyes— both form-base and eye-base have ceased for them there.
For whom and where the eye-base ceases, for them does the mind-base cease there?
For those attaining final Nibbāna in the Pure Abodes (suddhāvāsa), the eye-base ceases there, but the mind-base has not ceased there for them.
For others who are passing away while possessing the eye, both the eye-base and...
The mind-base ceases, and it has ceased.
Or, for whomsoever the mind-base has ceased at a certain place, does the eye-base cease for them at that same place?
For those being reborn in the five-aggregate realm who are without eyes, and for those passing away from the sense-sphere realm who are formless— for these, at that place...

The mind-base has ceased for them, but the eye-base does not cease for them there. For those who are passing away while possessing the eye, the mind-base has ceased and the eye-base also ceases there.
For whomsoever the eye-base ceases there, has the dhamma-base ceased for them there?
For those attaining final nibbāna in the Pure Abodes, the eye-base ceases there,
but the mental-object-base had not ceased for them there. For others who are passing away while possessing the eye, both the eye-base and the mental-object-base cease there,
and the mental-object-base had also ceased for them there.
Or conversely: for whomsoever the base of mental phenomena (*dhammāyatana*) had ceased at a certain place, does the base of the eye (*cakkhāyatana*) cease for them there?

For all those who are being reborn and for those who are passing away without eyes, the base of mental phenomena had ceased there, but the base of the eye does not cease for them there. For those who are passing away with eyes, [the base of the eye ceases there].
The base of mental phenomena (*dhammāyatana*) had ceased and the eye-base (*cakkhāyatana*) is ceasing. (End of the section based on the eye-base.
For whom, where the nose-base (*ghānāyatana*) ceases, has the visible-form base (*rūpāyatana*) ceased there? Yes.
Or conversely, for whom, where the visible-form base had ceased, does the nose-base cease there?
For those being reborn in the sense sphere who are without a nose, and for those passing away from the sense sphere or the fine-material sphere,
the visible-object base has ceased there, but the nose-base does not cease there for them. For those passing away with a nose, both the visible-object base and the nose-base have ceased there.
For whom, where the nose-base ceases, does the mind-base cease there? Yes.
Or rather, for whom, where the mind-base has ceased, does the nose-base cease there?
For those being reborn in the sense-sphere who are without a nose, for those passing away from the sense-sphere, and for those of the fine-material sphere and immaterial sphere.
For them, the mind-base had ceased there, but the nose-base does not cease there for them.
For those who are passing away with a nose, the mind-base had ceased there and the nose-base also ceases there.
For whomsoever the nose-base ceases there, has the dhamma-base ceased there for them? Yes.
Or conversely, for whomsoever the base of mental phenomena (dhammāyatana) has ceased at a certain place, does the base of the nose (ghānāyatana) cease for them there?

For all those who are being reborn and for those who are passing away without a nose, the base of mental phenomena has ceased there, but the base of the nose does not cease for them there. For those who are passing away with a nose... [the base of the nose ceases].
The sphere of mental phenomena (dhammāyatana) had ceased, and the sphere of the nose (ghānāyatana) is ceasing. (Based on the sphere of the nose.
For whom, where the sphere of visible form (rūpāyatana) ceases, does the sphere of mind (manāyatana) have ceased there?

For those passing away in the Pure Abodes (suddhāvāsa) and for those passing away from the non-percipient beings (asaññasatta), the sphere of visible form ceases there, but [the sphere of mind has not ceased].
And for those [beings], the mind-base had not ceased there. For others passing away from the five-aggregate plane, both the visible-object base and the mind-base cease there.
Or else, for whomsoever the mind-base had ceased there, does the visible-object base cease there for that person?
For those being reborn in the five-aggregate realm and for those in the formless realm, the mind base has ceased there,
but the visible-form base does not cease there for them. For those passing away from the five-aggregate realm, both the mind base and the visible-form base have ceased there.
For whom does the base of visible form cease at a particular place, and for that same person had the base of mental phenomena ceased at that same place?
For those attaining final nibbāna in the Pure Abodes, the base of visible form ceases there, but the base of mental phenomena had not ceased for them there.
For others who possess a physical body and are passing away, both the base of visible form and...
Does the base of mental phenomena (dhammāyatana) cease there?
Or, conversely, for whomsoever the base of mental phenomena has ceased at a certain place, does the base of visible form (rūpāyatana) cease for them at that same place?
For all those who are being reborn and for those of the formless realm passing away, the base of mental phenomena has ceased at that place.

And for them, the visible-object base does not cease there. For those passing away while possessing the visible form, both the mental-object base and the visible-object base have ceased and are ceasing there. (End of the section based on the visible-object base.
For whom, where the mind-base ceases, has the mental-object base ceased there?
For those attaining final nibbāna in the Pure Abodes, the mind base ceases there, but the mental-object base had not ceased for them there.
For others who are passing away with a conscious mind, both the mind base and the mental-object base cease there,
and the mental-object base had also ceased for them there.
Or conversely, for whomsoever the base of mental phenomena (dhammāyatana) has ceased at a certain place, does the base of mind (manāyatana) cease for them at that same place?
For all those being reborn and for those passing away who are without consciousness, the base of mental phenomena has ceased there, but the base of mind does not cease for them there.
For those passing away who possess consciousness, both the base of mental phenomena and...
The mind-base has ceased and the mind-base is also ceasing.
3.2.2.4.4. Negative Person (Paccanīka-puggala):
For whom the eye-base does not cease, has the ear-base not ceased for them? It has ceased.
Or, for whom ear-base had not ceased, does eye-base not cease for them? None.
For whom eye-base … [and so on] … nose-base … [and so on] … visible-object-base … [and so on] … mind-base does not cease, has dhamma-base not ceased for them? It has ceased.
Or, for whom dhamma-base had not ceased, does mind-base not cease for them? None.
3.2.2.4.5. Negative Plane (Paccanīka-okāsa):
Where the eye-base does not cease …pe… 3.2.2.4.6.
Negative Person-Plane (Paccanīka-puggalokāsa)
For whom the eye-base does not cease at a certain place, for that person has the ear-base not ceased there?
For those being reborn in the five-aggregate realm, and for those passing away from the sense-sphere who are without eyes, the eye-base does not cease there;
yet, for them, the ear-base has not [previously] ceased there. For those being reborn in the Pure Abodes...
For non-percipient beings and for those in the formless realm, neither the eye-base nor the ear-base has ceased there. Or conversely:
for whomsoever the ear-base has not ceased at a certain place, does the eye-base not cease for them there?
For those passing away into final Nibbāna in the Pure Abodes (Suddhāvāsa), the ear-base has not ceased there, yet it is not that the eye-base does not cease for them.

In that case, the eye base does not cease. For those being reborn in the Pure Abodes, for non-percipient beings, and for those in the formless realm, neither the ear base has ceased nor does the eye base cease there.
For whomsoever the eye base does not cease in a certain place, has the nose base not ceased for them in that same place?
For those being reborn in the sense-sphere realm who are without eyes, and for those passing away from the sense-sphere realm, the eye-base does not cease there,
but the nose-base has not failed to cease there for them. For those being reborn in the fine-material realm,
for non-percipient beings, and for those in the immaterial realm, neither the eye-base nor the nose-base has ceased there.
Or conversely: for whomsoever, wherever the nose-base has not ceased, does the eye-base not cease there for them?
For those passing away from the fine-material sphere, the nose-base has not ceased there, but it is not the case that the eye-base does not cease there for them.
For those being reborn in the fine-material sphere, for non-percipient beings, and for those in the immaterial sphere, [the nose-base has not ceased, and the eye-base does not cease].
In that case, the nose-base has not ceased and the eye-base does not cease.
For whom, where the eye-base does not cease, has the visible-object-base not ceased there?
For those being reborn in the five-aggregate realm, for those of the sense-sphere dying without eyes, and for non-percipient beings—for them [the visible-object-base has not ceased].
In that case, the eye-base does not cease for them there, but the visible-object-base has not ceased for them there.
For those being reborn in the Pure Abodes (Suddhāvāsa) and for those in the formless realm (Arūpa), neither the eye-base nor the visible-object-base has ceased there.
Or conversely: for whomsoever the visible-object-base has not ceased there, does the eye-base not cease for them there?
For those attaining final nibbāna in the Suddhāvāsa heavens, the visible-object base has not ceased there,
but the eye-base does not fail to cease for them there. For those being reborn in the Suddhāvāsa heavens and for those in the formless realms,
neither the visible-object base nor the eye-base has ceased there.
For whom the eye-base does not cease at a certain place, for that person has the mind-base not ceased there?

For those being reborn in the five-aggregate realm who are without eyes, for those passing away from the sense-sphere, and for those in the formless realm—the eye-base does not cease there for them, but it is not the case that the mind-base has not ceased there for them. [In the case of] the Pure Abodes...
For those beings who are being reborn among the non-percipient beings (*asaññasatta*), neither the eye-base (*cakkhāyatana*) nor the mind-base (*manāyatana*) has ceased there.
Or conversely: for whomsoever the mind-base has not ceased there, does the eye-base not cease there for them?
For those who are attaining final Nibbāna in the Pure Abodes (*suddhāvāsa*), the mind-base has not ceased there, yet it is not the case that the eye-base has not ceased for them.
In that case, the eye-base does not cease. For those being reborn in the Pure Abodes (Suddhāvāsa) and for non-percipient beings (asaññasatta), neither the mind-base nor the eye-base has ceased there.
For whom, where the eye-base does not cease, has the mental-object-base (dhammāyatana) not ceased there?
For all those being reborn and for those who are passing away without eye-sense, the eye-base does not cease there,
yet the mental-object-base has not failed to cease there for them. For those being reborn in the Pure Abodes,
neither the eye-base nor the mental-object-base has ceased there.
Or conversely, for whomsoever the base of mental phenomena (dhammāyatana) had not ceased at a certain place, does the base of the eye (cakkhāyatana) not cease for them there?
For those attaining final Nibbāna in the Pure Abodes (suddhāvāsa), the base of mental phenomena had not ceased there, yet the base of the eye does not fail to cease for them there.
For those being reborn in the Pure Abodes, both the base of mental phenomena and...
The eye-base has not ceased, and it does not cease. (End of the section based on the eye-base.

For whom, where the nose-base does not cease, does the visible-object-base not cease there? For those being reborn in the sense-sphere, for those in the sense-sphere who are without a nose, and for those in the fine-material sphere—[for these, the visible-object-base does not cease].
In that case, the nose base does not cease for them there, but the visible-form base has not ceased for them there.
For those pure-abode beings and for those immaterial beings, neither the nose base nor the visible-form base has ceased there.
Or conversely: for whomsoever the visible-form base has not ceased there, does the nose base not cease for him there? Yes.
For whom and where the nose-base does not cease, for that person there, did the mind-base not cease?

For those being reborn in the sense-sphere who are without a nose, for those passing away from the sense-sphere, and for those of the fine-material and immaterial spheres— the nose-base does not cease there,
but it is not the case that the mind-base has not ceased there for them.
For the beings of the Pure Abodes and for non-percipient beings, neither the nose base nor the mind base has ceased there.
Or conversely: for whomsoever the mind base has not ceased in a certain place, has the nose base not ceased for them there? Yes.
For whomsoever the nose base has not ceased in a certain place, has the mental-object base not ceased for them there?
For all those being reborn and for those who are dying without a nose, the nose-base does not cease there,
yet it is not the case that the mental-object-base has not ceased there for them. For those in the Pure Abodes,
neither the nose-base nor the mental-object-base has ceased there.

Or rather: For whomsoever the base of mental phenomena (*dhammāyatana*) had not ceased at a certain place, for that person does the base of the nose (*ghānāyatana*) not cease at that place? Yes. (End of the section based on the nose-base.
For whomsoever the base of visible form (*rūpāyatana*) does not cease at a certain place, for that person had the mind-base (*manāyatana*) not ceased at that place?

For those being reborn in the five-aggregate realm (*pañcavokāra*) and for those non-material beings (*arūpa*), the base of visible form does not cease there; yet it is not the case [that the mind-base had not ceased].

For those [beings], the mind-base had not ceased there. For those being reborn in the Pure Abodes (suddhāvāsa) and for those being reborn among the non-percipient beings (asaññasatta), neither the visible-form base nor the mind-base has ceased there.
Or conversely: for whomsoever the mind-base had not ceased there, for that person does the visible-form base not cease there?
For those attaining final nibbāna in the Pure Abodes and for those passing away from the non-percipient beings, the mind base had not ceased there,

but the visible-form base does not fail to cease there for them. For those being reborn in the Pure Abodes and for those being reborn among the non-percipient beings, neither the mind base nor the visible-form base has ceased there.
For whom and where the visible-object base does not cease, for them and there the mental-object base has not ceased?

For all those being reborn and for those non-material beings passing away, the visible-object base does not cease there, but it is not that the mental-object base has not ceased for them there. For those being reborn in the Pure Abodes...
In that case, the visible-object base does not cease and the mental-object base has not ceased.
Or rather: for whomsoever the mental-object base has not ceased at a certain place, does the visible-object base not cease for them there?
For those attaining final Nibbāna in the Pure Abodes, the mental-object base has not ceased there, yet for them the visible-object base does not [necessarily] cease.
In that case, the visible-form base does not cease. For those being reborn in the Pure Abodes, neither the mental-object base nor the visible-form base has ceased there.
For whom, where the mind base does not cease, has the mental-object base not ceased there?
For all those being reborn and for those mindless beings passing away, the mind base does not cease there,
yet it is not the case that the mental-object base had not ceased there for them. For those being reborn in the Pure Abodes,
neither the mind base nor the mental-object base has ceased there.
Or conversely: for whomsoever the base of mental phenomena (dhammāyatana) had not ceased at a certain place, does the base of mind (manāyatana) not cease for them there?
For those attaining final Nibbāna in the Pure Abodes (suddhāvāsa), the base of mental phenomena had not ceased there, yet the base of mind does not fail to cease for them there.
For those being reborn in the Pure Abodes, both the base of mental phenomena and...
The mind-base did not cease and the mind-base does not cease.
3.2.2.5. Chapter on the Present and Future. 3.2.2.5.1.
Positive Person.
For whom the eye-base ceases, will the ear-base cease for them?

For those attaining final Nibbāna in the five-aggregate realm, and for those who, having been reborn in the formless realm, will attain final Nibbāna at the moment of death—the eye-base ceases for them, but the ear-base will not cease for them. For others, however, it is so provided they possess the eye.
For those who are passing away, does the eye-base cease and the ear-base also cease?
Or, for whomsoever the ear-base will cease, does the eye-base cease for them?
For all those being reborn and for those who are passing away without eyes, the ear-base will cease.
And yet, the eye-base does not cease for them. For those who are passing away while possessing the eye, the ear-base will cease and the eye-base also ceases.
For whom the eye-base ceases, will the nose-base cease for that person?
For those attaining final nibbāna in the five-aggregate realm, and for those who, having been reborn in the fine-material or immaterial realms,

will attain final nibbāna there— at the moment of their death, the eye-base ceases for them, but the nose-base will not cease for them. For others who are dying while possessing the eye, both the eye-base ceases and the nose-base will cease.
Or alternatively, for whom the nose-base ceases … [and so on] … For whom the eye-base ceases, will the visible-object-base cease for them?
For those attaining final Nibbāna in the five-aggregate plane, and for those who, having been reborn in the formless plane, will attain final Nibbāna at the moment of death.

For them, the eye-base ceases, but the visible-object-base will not cease for them. For others who are passing away while possessing the eye, both the eye-base ceases and the visible-object-base will cease.
Or else, for whom the visible-object-base [ceases]... (and so on).
For whom the eye-base ceases, will the mind-base …pe… the mental-object-base cease for them?
For those attaining final Nibbāna in the five-aggregate plane, the eye-base ceases, but the mental-object-base will not cease for them.
For others who are passing away while possessing the eye, both the eye-base and [the other bases] cease.
And the mental-object base (dhammāyatana) will cease.
Or rather, for whom the mental-object base will cease, does the eye-base (cakkhāyatana) cease for them?
For all those being reborn, and for those passing away who are without eyes... [and] for those passing away who possess eyes... [end of ellipsis].
For whom the nose-base ceases, will the visible-object-base cease for them?

For those attaining final nibbāna in the sense-sphere realm, and for those who, having been reborn in the formless realm, will attain final nibbāna at the moment of death—their nose-base ceases, but the visible-object-base will not cease for them. For others who possess a nose...
For those who are passing away, does the nose-base cease and the visible-object-base also cease?
Or, conversely, for whomsoever the visible-object-base will cease, does the nose-base cease for them?
For all those being reborn and for those who are passing away without a nose, the visible-object-base will cease, but [the nose-base does not].
And for them, the nose-base ceases. For those who are passing away while possessing a nose, will the visible-object-base cease and the nose-base also cease?
For whom the nose-base ceases, will the mind-base … pe … the mental-object-base cease for them?
For those attaining final nibbāna in the sense-sphere realm, the nose base ceases, but the mental-object base will not cease for them.
For others who are passing away while possessing a nose, both the nose base ceases and the mental-object base will cease.
Or, for whomsoever the mental-object base [ceases]... [and so on].
For whom the base of visible form ceases, for them will the base of mental phenomena cease?
For those attaining final nibbāna in the five-aggregate realm, the base of visible form ceases, but the base of mental phenomena will not cease for them.
For others who are passing away while still possessing the material body, both the base of visible form ceases and the base of mental phenomena will cease.
Or, for whomsoever the base of mental phenomena (dhammāyatana) will cease, does the base of visible form (rūpāyatana) cease for them?
For all those being reborn and for those of the formless realm passing away, the base of mental phenomena will cease, but the base of visible form does not cease for them.
For those of the world with form passing away, both the base of mental phenomena and...
The visible base will cease and the visible base is also ceasing.
For whom the mind base ceases, will the mental-object base cease for them?
For those who are attaining final Nibbāna, the mind base ceases, but the mental-object base will not cease for them.
For those others who possess consciousness at the moment of death, the mind-base (manāyatana) ceases and the mental-object base (dhammāyatana) will cease.
Or, for whomsoever the mental-object base will cease, does the mind-base cease for them?
For all those being reborn and for those who die without consciousness, the mental-object base will cease.
And for them, the mind-base does not cease. For those who are passing away with a mind, both the mental-object-base will cease and the mind-base ceases. 3.2.2.5.2.
Positive Plane (Anuloma-okāsa)
Where the eye-base ceases … [as before] … 3.2.2.5.3.
Positive Person-Space (Anuloma-Puggalokāsa):
For whom, where the eye-base ceases, will the ear-base cease there?
For those attaining final nibbāna in the five-aggregate plane, the eye-base ceases there,
but the ear-base will not cease there for them. For others who are passing away while possessing the eye, both the eye-base and the ear-base cease there.
Or again, for whomsoever the ear-base will cease at a certain place, does the eye-base cease for that person at that place?

For those being reborn in the five-aggregate realm and for those passing away from the sense-sphere who are without eyes, the ear-base will cease there, but the eye-base does not cease for them there. For those passing away who possess eyes...
For those persons, the ear-base will cease there and the eye-base is ceasing there.
For whomsoever the eye-base is ceasing there, will the nose-base cease for them there?
For those who are attaining final nibbāna in the sense-sphere realm and for those passing away from the fine-material sphere, the eye-base is ceasing there.

And for them, the nose base will not cease there. For others who possess the eye base while passing away from the sense-sphere realm, both the eye base and the nose base cease there. Or rather, for whomsoever the nose base [ceases] where...
(*pe*) ... (Just as this was explained in three ways regarding the present and the past, so too should it be explained here.)
For whom and where the eye-base ceases, for them will the visible-object-base cease there?
For those attaining final Nibbāna in the five-aggregate realm, the eye-base ceases there, but the visible-object-base will not cease for them there.
For others who are passing away while possessing the eye, both the eye-base and [the visible-object-base] cease there.
The visible-object base ceases and will also cease.
Or, for whom and where the visible-object base [ceases]… [as before]… For whom and where the eye-base ceases, does the mind-base cease for that person at that location?
For those attaining final nibbāna in the five-aggregate realm, the eye-base ceases there,
but the mind-base will not cease there for them. For others who are passing away while possessing the eye, both the eye-base and the mind-base cease there.
Or again, for whomsoever the mind-base ceases at a certain place … [as before] … For whomsoever the eye-base ceases at a certain place, will the mental-object-base cease for them there?
In the case of those attaining final Nibbāna in the five-aggregate realm, the eye-base ceases for them there, but the mental-object-base does not cease for them there.

The base of mental phenomena (dhammāyatana) will cease. For those others who possess the eye and are passing away, both the eye-base (cakkhāyatana) ceases and the base of mental phenomena will cease there. Or conversely:
for whomsoever the base of mental phenomena will cease there, does the eye-base cease for them there?

For all those being reborn and for those who are eyeless at the moment of death, the base of mental phenomena (*dhammāyatana*) will cease there, but the eye-base (*cakkhāyatana*) does not cease for them there.
For those with eyes at the moment of death, both the base of mental phenomena and the eye-base will cease there. (Based on the eye-base.)
For whom and where the nose-base ceases, for them will the visible-object-base cease there?
For those attaining final nibbāna in the sense-sphere realm, the nose-base ceases there, but the visible-object-base will not cease there for them.
For others who are passing away with their nose intact, both the nose-base and [the visible-object-base] cease there.
Does the visible-object base cease, and will the nose-base also cease?

Or, conversely, for whomsoever the nose-base will cease at a certain place, does the visible-object base cease for them there? For those attaining final nibbāna in the sense-sphere realm, the visible-object base ceases there, but [the nose-base] will not cease...

For those being reborn in the sense-sphere realm who are without a nose, and for those passing away from the sense-sphere realm or belonging to the fine-material sphere, the visible-object base ceases there, but [the nose-base] will not cease... [and so on].
For whom and where the nose-base ceases, for them will the mind-base …pe… the mental-object-base cease there?
For those attaining final nibbāna in the sense-sphere realm, the nose-base ceases there, but the mental-object-base will not cease for them there.
For others who are passing away with their nose intact, both the nose-base and [the other bases] cease there.
The base of mental phenomena ceases and will also cease.
Or, for whomsoever at whatever place the base of mental phenomena [ceases]… [as before].
For whomsoever at whatever place the base of visible form ceases, will for that person at that place the base of mind cease?
For those attaining final nibbāna in the five-aggregate plane and for those passing away from the non-percipient beings, the visible-form base ceases there,
but the mind base will not cease there for them. For others passing away from the five-aggregate plane, both the visible-form base and the mind base cease there.

Or again, for whomsoever there is the mind-base (*manāyatana*) at a certain place … [as before] … For whomsoever the visible-form base (*rūpāyatana*) ceases at a certain place, will the mental-object base (*dhammāyatana*) cease for them at that same place?
For those attaining final nibbāna (*parinibbāna*) in the five-aggregate realm (*pañcavokāra*), the visible-form base ceases there, but the mental-object base does not cease for them there.

The base of mental phenomena (dhammāyatana) will cease. For those passing away who possess material form, both the base of visible forms (rūpāyatana) ceases and the base of mental phenomena will cease there.
Or conversely, for whomsoever the base of mental phenomena will cease in a certain place, does the base of visible forms cease for them there?
For all those who are being reborn and for those immaterial beings who are passing away, the base of mental phenomena (dhammāyatana) will cease there,

but the base of visible forms (rūpāyatana) does not cease for them there. For those with material form who are passing away, both the base of mental phenomena and the base of visible forms cease there.
For whom and where the mind-base ceases, for them will the mental-object-base cease there?
For those attaining final Nibbāna, the mind-base ceases there, but for them the mental-object-base will not cease there.
For others who are passing away with a mind, both the mind-base and the mental-object-base cease there.
And the base of mental phenomena (dhammāyatana) will cease.
Or rather: for whom, and where, the base of mental phenomena will cease, does the base of mind (manāyatana) cease for them there?
For all those being reborn and for those passing away who are without consciousness, the base of mental phenomena will cease there.
And for them, the mind-base does not cease there. For those who are passing away with a mind, the mental-object-base will cease and the mind-base also ceases there. 3.2.2.5.4.
Negative Person (Paccanīka-puggala)
For whom the eye-base does not cease, will the ear-base not cease for them?
For all those who are being reborn and for those who are passing away without eyes, the eye-base does not cease, yet it is not the case that the ear-base will not cease for them.
For those in the final existence in the formless realm, neither the eye-base nor...
The ear-base does not cease and will not cease.
Or, for whom the ear-base will not cease, does the eye-base not cease for them?
For those attaining final nibbāna in the five-aggregate realm, and for those who, having been reborn in the formless realm, will attain final nibbāna at the moment of death.
For those persons, the ear-base will not cease, but the eye-base does not fail to cease for them.
For those final-existence beings in the formless realm, neither the ear-base nor the eye-base ceases.
For one whose eye-base does not cease, will the nose-base not cease for that person?
For all those being reborn and for those passing away who are without eyes, the eye-base does not cease,

yet the nose-base will not fail to cease for them. For those attaining final existence in the fine-material sphere and for those attaining final existence in the immaterial sphere, neither the eye-base nor the nose-base ceases, nor will they cease.
Or again, for whom the nose-base will not cease, does the eye-base not cease for them?

For those attaining final nibbāna in the five-aggregate realm, and for those who, having been reborn in the fine-material or immaterial realms, will attain final nibbāna there— at the moment of their death,
the nose-base will not cease for them, but the eye-base does not [fail to cease] for them.

It ceases. For those attaining rebirth in the fine-material sphere (rūpāvacara) as final-existence beings, and for those final-existence beings in the immaterial sphere (arūpa), neither the nose base nor the eye base ceases.
For one in whom the eye base does not cease, will the visible-object base not cease?
For all those being reborn and for those passing away who are without eyes, the eye-base does not cease,
yet it is not the case that the visible-object-base will not cease for them. For those in the final existence in the formless realm,
neither the eye-base nor the visible-object-base will cease.
Or alternatively: for whom the visible-object base will not cease, does the eye-base not cease for them?

For those attaining final Nibbāna in the five-aggregate plane, and for those who, having been reborn in the immaterial plane, will attain final Nibbāna at the moment of death—for these, the visible-object base will not cease, but it is not the case that the eye-base does not cease for them. In the immaterial plane...
For those in their final existence, the visible-object base will not cease and the eye-base does not cease.
For one whose eye-base does not cease, will the mind-base … pe … the mental-object base not cease?
For all those being reborn and for those passing away who are without eyes, the eye-base does not cease.

And for them, the base of mental phenomena (dhammāyatana) will not cease. For those attaining final nibbāna in the formless realm (arūpa), neither the eye-base (cakkhāyatana) ceases nor will the base of mental phenomena cease. Or conversely:
for whomsoever the base of mental phenomena will not cease, does the eye-base not cease for them?
For those attaining final nibbāna in the five-aggregate plane, the base of mental phenomena will not cease, yet the eye base does not fail to cease for them.
For those attaining final nibbāna in the immaterial plane, neither the base of mental phenomena nor the eye base ceases.
For whom the nose base does not cease, will the visible-object base not cease for them?
For all those being reborn and for those passing away who are without nose-faculty, the nose-base does not cease,
yet the visible-object-base will not fail to cease for them. For those attaining final Nibbāna in the fine-material sphere and for those in their last existence in the immaterial sphere,
neither the nose-base nor the visible-object-base will cease.
Or rather, for whom the visible-object base will not cease, does the nose-base not cease for them?

For those passing away in the sense-sphere realm who are attaining final nibbāna, and for those who, having been reborn in the formless realm, will attain final nibbāna at the moment of death—the visible-object base will not cease for them, but it is not the case that the nose-base does not cease for them. In the fine-material sphere...
For those attaining final Nibbāna in the formless realm who are in their last existence, the sphere of visible form will not cease, and the sphere of the nose does not cease.
For whom the sphere of the nose does not cease, will the sphere of the mind …pe… the sphere of mental phenomena not cease?
For all those being reborn and for those passing away who are without a nose, the sphere of the nose does not cease.

And yet, for them, the base of mental phenomena (dhammāyatana) will not cease. For those attaining final nibbāna in the fine-material sphere or the immaterial sphere, neither the nose base (ghānāyatana) nor the base of mental phenomena ceases. Or conversely:
for whomsoever the base of mental phenomena will not cease, does the nose base not cease for them?
For those attaining final nibbāna in the sense sphere, the base of mental phenomena will not cease,
but the nose base does not fail to cease for them. For those attaining final nibbāna in the fine-material sphere or the immaterial sphere,
both the base of mental phenomena will not cease and the nose base does not cease.
For whom the visible-object base does not cease, for them the mind base …pe… will the mental-object base not cease?
For all those who are being reborn and for those of the formless realm passing away, the visible-object base does not cease, yet for them the mental-object base will not fail to cease.
For those attaining final Nibbāna in the formless realm, the visible-object base [does not cease] …pe… [and the mental-object base will not cease].
The base of mental phenomena (dhammāyatana) does not cease, nor will it cease.
Or, for whom the base of mental phenomena will not cease, does the base of visible forms (rūpāyatana) not cease for them?
For those attaining final nibbāna in the five-aggregate realm (pañcavokāra), the base of mental phenomena will not cease, but for them the base of visible forms does not [necessarily] cease.
It does not cease. For those attaining final nibbāna in the formless realm, the base of mental phenomena will not cease and the base of visible forms does not cease.
Does the base of mental phenomena not cease for one for whom the base of mind does not cease? It will cease.
Or rather, does the base of mind not cease for one for whom the base of mental phenomena will not cease? It ceases.
3.2.2.5.5. Negative Plane (Paccanīka-okāsa):
Where the eye-base does not cease …pe… 3.2.2.5.6.
Negative Person-Plane (Paccanīka-puggalokāsa)
For whom and where the eye-base does not cease, for them there will the ear-base not cease there?
For those being reborn in the five-aggregate realm who are without eyes, and for those passing away from the sense-sphere realm, the eye-base does not cease there;
yet for them, the ear-base will not fail to cease there. [This is so] for non-percipient beings and for those in the formless realm.
For those persons, the eye-base does not cease there, and the ear-base will not cease there.
Or else, for whomsoever the ear-base will not cease there, does the eye-base not cease there for them?
For those attaining final Nibbāna in the five-aggregate realm, the ear-base will not cease there, but it is not the case that the eye-base does not cease for them there.
In that case, the eye base does not cease. For non-percipient beings and for those in the formless realm, neither will the ear base cease nor does the eye base cease there.
For whom, where the eye base does not cease, will the nose base not cease there?
For those being reborn in the sense sphere who are without eyes, and for those passing away from the sense sphere, the eye base does not cease there,
yet the nose base will not fail to cease for them there. For those being reborn in the fine-material sphere,
for non-percipient beings, and for those in the immaterial sphere, neither the eye base nor the nose base ceases there.
Or again, for whomsoever the nose-base will not cease at a certain place, does the eye-base not cease for them there?

For those attaining final nibbāna in the sense-sphere (kāmāvacara) and for those passing away from the fine-material sphere (rūpāvacara), the nose-base will not cease there, but the eye-base does not fail to cease for them there.
[This is so] for those being reborn in the fine-material sphere and for non-percipient beings (asaññasatta).
For those immaterial beings, neither the nose base nor the eye base will cease there.
For whom the eye base does not cease at a certain place, will the visible-object base not cease for them at that same place?
For those being reborn in the five-aggregate realm, for those of the sense-sphere dying who are without eyes, and for non-percipient beings—for these, [the visible-object base does not cease].
In that case, the eye-base does not cease for them there, yet the visible-object-base will not fail to cease for them there.
For those immaterial beings, neither the eye-base nor the visible-object-base will cease there.
Or conversely: for whomsoever the visible-object-base will not cease there, for that person does the eye-base not cease there?
For those attaining final nibbāna in the five-aggregate plane, the visible-object base will not cease there,
but the eye-base does not fail to cease for them there. For those in the formless realm,
neither the visible-object base nor the eye-base ceases there.
For whom the eye-base does not cease at a certain place, will the mind-base not cease for them at that same place?

For those being reborn in the five-aggregate realm, for those in the sense-sphere who are devoid of eyes while passing away, and for those in the formless realm—the eye-base does not cease for them there, but it is not the case that the mind-base will not cease for them there. In the formless realm...
For those attaining final nibbāna among non-percipient beings, the eye-base does not cease there and the mind-base will not cease there.
Or, for whomsoever the mind-base will not cease at a certain place, does the eye-base not cease for them there?
For those attaining final nibbāna in the five-aggregate realm, the mind-base will not cease there, yet it is not the case that the eye-base does not cease for them there.
In that case, the eye-base does not cease. For those attaining final nibbāna in the formless realm and for non-percipient beings, neither the mind-base nor the eye-base will cease there.
For whom, where the eye-base does not cease, will the mental-object-base not cease there?
For all those being reborn and for those who are passing away without eye-sensitivity, the eye-base does not cease there;

yet it is not the case that the mental-object-base will not cease for them there. For those attaining final Nibbāna in the formless realm, neither the eye-base nor the mental-object-base ceases there.
Or conversely: for whomsoever the base of mental phenomena (dhammāyatana) will not cease at a certain place, does the eye-base (cakkhāyatana) not cease for them there?
For those attaining final nibbāna in the five-aggregate realm (pañcavokāra), the base of mental phenomena will not cease there, yet the eye-base does not fail to cease for them there.
For those attaining final nibbāna in the formless realm (arūpa), both the base of mental phenomena and...
The eye-base will not cease, and the eye-base does not cease. (Based on the eye-base.
For whom the nose-base does not cease at a certain place, for that person will the visible-object-base not cease at that same place?
For those who are being reborn in the sense-sphere, for those sense-sphere beings who are not possessed of a nose, and for those of the fine-material sphere—[for these, the nose-base does not cease].
In that case, the nose base does not cease, yet the visible-object base will not fail to cease for those [beings] there.
For those attaining final nibbāna in the fine-material sphere and for those immaterial beings, neither the nose base nor the visible-object base ceases there.
Or conversely: for whomsoever the visible-object base will not cease there, does the nose base not cease for them there?
For those attaining final nibbāna in the sense-sphere realm, the visible-object base will not cease there,
but the nose-base does not fail to cease for them there. For those attaining final nibbāna in the fine-material realm and for those non-percipient beings,
both the visible-object base and the nose-base will not cease there.
