For whom the nose-base does not cease at a certain place, will the mind-base not cease for them at that place?

For those being reborn in the sense-sphere who are without a nose, for those passing away from the sense-sphere, and for those of the fine-material and immaterial spheres—the nose-base does not cease for them there;
yet it is not the case that the mind-base will not cease for them there.

For those attaining final nibbāna in the fine-material sphere, the immaterial sphere, or among non-percipient beings, the nose base does not cease there, nor will the mind base cease there. Or conversely:
for whomsoever the mind base will not cease at a certain place, does the nose base not cease for them at that place?
For those attaining final nibbāna in the sense-sphere realm (*kāmāvacara*), the mind-base (*manāyatana*) will not cease there,

yet the nose-base (*ghānāyatana*) does not fail to cease for them there. For those attaining final nibbāna in the fine-material sphere (*rūpāvacara*) or the immaterial sphere (*arūpāvacara*), and for non-percipient beings (*asaññasatta*),
neither the mind-base nor the nose-base ceases there.
For whom the nose-base does not cease at a certain place, will the mental-object-base not cease for them at that place?
For all those being reborn and for those passing away who are without a nose, the nose-base does not cease there, yet it is not the case that the mental-object-base will not cease for them there.
[This is also true] for those attaining final Nibbāna in the fine-material sphere and the immaterial sphere.
For them, neither the nose-base nor the mental-object-base ceases there.
Or else: for whomsoever the mental-object-base will not cease there, does the nose-base not cease for them there?
For those attaining final nibbāna in the sense-sphere realm, the mental-object-base will not cease there, but it is not that the nose-base does not cease for them.

In that case, the nose base does not cease. For those attaining final nibbāna in the fine-material sphere or the immaterial sphere, neither the mental-object base nor the nose base will cease there. (End of the section based on the nose base.
For whom, where the visible-object base does not cease, will the mind base not cease there?
For those being reborn in the five-aggregate realm and for those in the formless realm, the visible-object base does not cease there;

yet it is not the case that the mind base will not cease for them there. For those attaining final nibbāna in the formless realm and for those being reborn in the non-percipient realm, neither the visible-object base nor the mind base ceases there.
Or alternatively: for whomsoever the mind-base will not cease at a certain place, does the visible-form base not cease for them there?

For those attaining final Nibbāna in the five-aggregate realm and for those passing away from the non-percipient beings, the mind-base will not cease there, but it is not the case that the visible-form base does not cease for them there. For those attaining final Nibbāna in the formless realm and for non-percipient beings...
For those beings being reborn there, the mind-base will not cease and the visible-form base does not cease.
For whomsoever the visible-form base does not cease at a certain place, will the mental-object base not cease for them at that same place?
For all those being reborn and for those non-material beings passing away, the visible-form base does not cease at that place.

And yet, for them, the base of mental phenomena (dhammāyatana) will not cease there. For those attaining final nibbāna in the formless realm (arūpa), neither the base of visible forms (rūpāyatana) nor the base of mental phenomena ceases there. Or conversely:
for whomsoever the base of mental phenomena will not cease in a certain place, does the base of visible forms not cease for them in that same place?
For those attaining final Nibbāna in the five-aggregate plane, the base of mental phenomena will not cease there, yet the base of visible forms does not fail to cease for them there.
For those attaining final Nibbāna in the immaterial plane, neither the base of mental phenomena nor the base of visible forms will cease there. (The section based on the base of visible forms.)
For whom the mind-base does not cease at a certain place, will the mental-object-base not cease for that person at that place? It will cease.
Or rather, for whom the mental-object-base will not cease at a certain place, does the mind-base not cease for that person at that place? It ceases.
3.2.2.6. Chapter on the Past and Future.
3.2.2.6.1. Positive Person (Anulomapuggala) For whom eye-base has ceased, will ear-base cease for that person?

For those attaining final Nibbāna in the five-aggregate realm, for those in their final existence in the formless realm, and for those who, having been reborn in the formless realm, will attain final Nibbāna there.
For those who are passing away, the eye-base has ceased, but the ear-base will not cease for them.
For others, both the eye-base has ceased and the ear-base will cease.
Or, for whomsoever the ear-base will cease, has the eye-base ceased for them? Yes.
For whom the eye-base has ceased, will the nose-base cease for them?

For those passing away in the final existence in the sense-sphere realm (*kāmāvacara*), for those in their final existence in the fine-material sphere (*rūpāvacara*) or the immaterial sphere (*arūpāvacara*),
and for those who, having been reborn in the fine-material or immaterial spheres, will attain final nibbāna at the moment of death— for these, the eye-base has ceased.
And for them, the nose base will not cease. For others, however, both the eye base has ceased and the nose base will cease. Or for whom...? Yes.
For whom the eye-base has ceased, will the visible-object-base cease for them?
For those attaining final nibbāna in the five-aggregate realm, for those in their final existence in the formless realm, and for those who, having been reborn in the formless realm,
will attain final nibbāna at the moment of death— for these, the eye-base has ceased, but the visible-object-base will not cease for them.
In other cases, the eye-base has ceased and the visible-form base will cease for those persons.
Or, for whomsoever... [as before] ...Yes.
For whomsoever the eye-base has ceased, will the mind-base... [as before] ...or the mental-object base cease for that person?
For those who are attaining final Nibbāna, the eye-base has ceased, but the mental-object-base will not cease for them. For others, both the eye-base has ceased and the mental-object-base will cease.
Or, for whomsoever... [etc.]? Yes. (End of the section based on the eye-base.
For whomsoever the nose-base has ceased, will the visible-form-base cease for them?
For those attaining final nibbāna in the five-aggregate plane, for those in their final existence in the formless plane, and for those who, having been reborn in the formless plane,
will attain final nibbāna at the moment of death— the nose base has ceased for them,
but the visible-object base will not cease for them. For others, both the nose base has ceased and the visible-object base will cease.
Or again, for whomsoever... [as before] ...? Yes.
For whomsoever the nose-base has ceased, will the mind-base... [as before] ...the mental-object-base cease for them?

For those who are attaining final Nibbāna, the nose-base has ceased, but the mental-object-base will not cease for them. For others, both the nose-base has ceased and the mental-object-base will cease.
Or for whomsoever... [as before] ...? Yes.
For whomsoever the visible-object base (rūpāyatana) has ceased, will the mind-base (manāyatana)... [as before] ...the mental-object base (dhammāyatana) cease for them?

For those who are attaining final nibbāna (parinibbāna), the visible-object base has ceased, but the mental-object base will not cease for them. For others, both the visible-object base has ceased and the mental-object base will cease.
Or again, for whom... [as before] ...? Yes.
For whom the mind-base (*manāyatana*) has ceased, will the mental-object-base (*dhammāyatana*) cease for them?

For those who are attaining final nibbāna (*parinibbāna*), the mind-base has ceased, but the mental-object-base will not cease for them. For others, both the mind-base has ceased and the mental-object-base will cease.

3.2.2.6.3. Positive Person-Space (Anuloma-Puggalokāsa) In whom, where the eye-base has ceased, will the ear-base cease there?
For those attaining final Nibbāna in the five-aggregate realm, the eye-base has ceased there, but for them the ear-base will not [cease] there.
In that case, the ear-base will cease. For others belonging to the five-aggregate realm, both the eye-base has ceased and the ear-base will cease there.
Or rather, for whomsoever the ear-base will cease in a certain place, has the eye-base ceased for them in that same place?
For those being reborn in the Pure Abodes (Suddhāvāsa), the ear-base will cease there,
but the eye-base has not ceased there for them. For others belonging to the five-aggregate realm (pañcavokāra), both the ear-base will cease there and the eye-base has ceased there.
For whom, where the eye-base has ceased, will the nose-base cease there?
For those attaining final nibbāna in the sense-sphere and for those in the fine-material sphere, the eye-base has ceased there, but the nose-base will not cease there for them.
For others in the sense-sphere, [the nose-base will cease there].
The eye-base has ceased and the nose-base will cease.
Or, for whomsoever the nose-base will cease at a certain place, has the eye-base ceased there for them? Yes.
For whomsoever the eye-base has ceased at a certain place, will the visible-object-base cease there for them?
For those attaining final nibbāna in the five-aggregate realm, the eye-base had ceased there,
but the visible-object-base will not cease there for them. For others in the five-aggregate realm,
both the eye-base and the visible-object-base had ceased and will also cease there.
Or rather: for whomsoever the visible-object base will cease at a certain place, has the eye-base ceased for them there?
For those being reborn in the Pure Abodes and for non-percipient beings, the visible-object base will cease there, but the eye-base has not ceased for them there.
For others belonging to the five-aggregate realm, [both will have ceased].
The visible-object base will cease and the eye base has ceased.
For whomsoever the eye base has ceased at a certain place, will the mind base cease for that person at that same place?
For those attaining final nibbāna in the five-aggregate realm, the eye base has ceased there, but the mind base does not [cease] for them.
In that case, the mind-base will cease. For others belonging to the five-aggregate realm, both the eye-base has ceased and the mind-base will cease there.
Or, conversely, for whomsoever the mind-base will cease there, has the eye-base ceased for them there?
For those being reborn in the Pure Abodes and for those in the formless realm, the mind-base will cease there,
but the eye-base has not ceased there for them. For others belonging to the five-aggregate plane,
both the mind-base will cease there and the eye-base has ceased there.
For whom and where the eye-base has ceased, will the mental-object-base cease there for them?

For those attaining final nibbāna in the five-aggregate realm, the eye-base has ceased there, but the mental-object-base will not cease there for them. For others in the five-aggregate realm, both the eye-base and...
The base of mental phenomena (dhammāyatana) has ceased and will also cease.
Or, for whomsoever and wherever the base of mental phenomena will cease, has the eye-base (cakkhāyatana) ceased for them there?

For those being reborn in the Pure Abodes (suddhāvāsa), for non-percipient beings (asaññasatta), and for those in the formless realm (arūpa), the base of mental phenomena will cease there, but the eye-base has not ceased for them.

And for them, the eye-base had not ceased there. For others belonging to the five-aggregate plane, both the mental-object-base will cease and the eye-base had ceased there. (End of the section based on the eye-base.
For whomsoever the nose-base had ceased at a certain place, will the visible-form-base cease for that person at that same place?
For those attaining final nibbāna in the sense sphere, the nose base has ceased there,
but the visible-object base will not cease there for them. For others in the sense sphere, both the nose base and the visible-object base have ceased there and will also cease there.
Or alternatively: for whomsoever the visible base will cease at a certain place, has the nose base ceased for them at that place?
For those of the fine-material sphere, the visible base will cease there, but the nose base has not ceased for them there.
For those of the sense-sphere, both the visible base will cease there and the nose base has ceased there.
For whom, where the nose-base has ceased, will the mind-base …pe… the mental-object-base cease there?
For those attaining final nibbāna in the sense-sphere realm, the nose-base has ceased there, but the mental-object-base will not cease there for them.
For others in the sense-sphere realm, both the nose-base and the mental-object-base have ceased there.
And the base of mental phenomena (dhammāyatana) will cease.
Or else, for whomsoever and wherever the base of mental phenomena will cease, has the base of the nose (ghānāyatana) ceased for them there?
For those of the fine-material sphere (rūpāvacara) and those of the immaterial sphere (arūpāvacara), the base of mental phenomena will cease there, but the base of the nose has not ceased for them.
In that case, the nose-base has ceased. For those belonging to the sense-sphere, will the mental-object-base cease there and the nose-base have ceased there? (The section based on the nose-base.
For whomsoever the visible-form-base has ceased in a certain place, will the mind-base cease for them in that same place?
For those attaining final nibbāna in the five-aggregate plane and for non-percipient beings, the base of visible form has ceased there,
but the base of mind will not cease there for them. For others in the five-aggregate plane,
both the base of visible form and the base of mind have ceased there, and the base of mind will also cease there.
Or again, for whomsoever the mind-base will cease at a certain place, had the visible-form base ceased for them there?

For those being reborn in the Pure Abodes and for those in the formless realm, the mind-base will cease there, but the visible-form base had not ceased for them there. For others belonging to the five-aggregate plane, both the mind-base and...
Will the visible base cease, and has the visible base already ceased?
For one in whom the visible base has ceased at a certain place, will the mental-object base cease for them at that same place?
For those attaining final Nibbāna in the five-aggregate realm, the visible base has ceased there, but the mental-object base does not cease for them there.

The base of mental phenomena will cease. For others—namely, those in the five-aggregate planes and non-percipient beings—both the base of visible forms and the base of mental phenomena have ceased there.
Or rather, for whomsoever the base of mental phenomena will cease in a certain place, has the base of visible forms ceased there for them?
For those being reborn in the Pure Abodes and for those in the formless realm, the base of mental phenomena will cease there, but the base of visible forms has not ceased there for them.

For others—namely, those in the five-aggregate plane and non-percipient beings—both the base of mental phenomena and the base of visible forms will cease there. (The section based on the base of visible forms.)
For whom and where the mind-base (manāyatana) has ceased, for them will the mental-object-base (dhammāyatana) cease there?
For those who are attaining final Nibbāna, the mind-base has ceased there, but the mental-object-base will not cease there for them.
For others—those of the four-aggregate and five-aggregate realms—the mind-base has ceased there, and [the mental-object-base will also cease].
And the base of mental phenomena (dhammāyatana) will cease.
Or, for whomsoever and wherever the base of mental phenomena will cease, has the base of mind (manāyatana) ceased for them there?
For those being reborn in the Pure Abodes (suddhāvāsa) and for non-percipient beings (asaññasatta), the base of mental phenomena will cease there, but [the base of mind] has not ceased.
But for them, the mind-base did not cease there. For others—those in the four-constituent and five-constituent realms—the dhamma-base will cease there and the mind-base has ceased there.
3.2.2.6.4. Negative Person (Paccanīka-puggala)
For whom the eye-base had not ceased, will the ear-base not cease for them? None.
Or else, for whom the ear-base will not cease, had the eye-base not ceased for them? It had ceased.
For whom the eye-base … [and so on] … the nose-base … the visible-object-base … the mind-base had not ceased, will the mental-object-base not cease for them? None.
Or, for whom the sphere of mental objects (dhammāyatana) will not cease, for that person did the sphere of mind (manāyatana) not cease? It did cease.

3.2.2.6.6. Negative Person-Space (Paccanīka-Puggalokāsa) For whom eye-base had not ceased at a certain place, will ear-base not cease for them at that same place?
For those being reborn in the Pure Abodes (Suddhāvāsa), eye-base had not ceased there, yet for them [ear-base will not cease].

In that case, the ear-base will not cease. For those attaining final Nibbāna in the Pure Abodes, for non-percipient beings, and for those in the formless realm, neither the eye-base nor the ear-base has ceased there.
Or rather: for whomsoever the ear-base will not cease in a certain place, has the eye-base not ceased for them in that same place?
For those attaining final nibbāna in the five-aggregate realm, the ear-base will not cease there,
but the eye-base has not [previously] ceased for them there. For those attaining final nibbāna in the Pure Abodes, for non-percipient beings, and for those in the formless realm,
neither the ear-base nor the eye-base has ceased there.
For whom the eye-base has not ceased at a certain place, will the nose-base not cease for them at that same place? Yes.
Or rather, for whom the nose-base will not cease at a certain place, has the eye-base not ceased for them at that same place?
For those who are attaining final Nibbāna in the sense-sphere realm and for those in the fine-material sphere, the nose-base will not cease at that place.

And for them, the eye-base had not ceased there. For those in the Pure Abodes, for non-percipient beings, and for those in the formless realm, the nose-base will not cease there and the eye-base had not ceased there.
For whomsoever the eye-base had not ceased at a certain place, will the visible-object-base not cease for that person at that same place?
For those being reborn in the Pure Abodes and for non-percipient beings, the eye-base has not ceased there,
yet the visible-object-base will not fail to cease for them there. For those attaining final Nibbāna in the Pure Abodes and for those in the formless realm,
neither the eye-base nor the visible-object-base will cease there.
Or again, for whomsoever the visible base will not cease at a certain place, has the eye base not ceased for them there?
For those attaining final Nibbāna in the five-aggregate realm, the visible base will not cease there, yet the eye base has not failed to cease for them there.
For those attaining final Nibbāna in the Pure Abodes and for those in the formless realm, [the visible base will not cease there, and the eye base has not ceased for them there].
The visible-object base will not cease, and the eye base has not ceased.
For whom, where the eye base has not ceased, will the mind base not cease there?
For those being reborn in the Pure Abodes and for those non-percipient beings, the eye base has not ceased there, but [the mind base will not cease]. No.

And for them, the mind-base will not cease there. For those attaining final nibbāna in the Pure Abodes, for those attaining final nibbāna in the formless realm, and for non-percipient beings, the eye-base had not ceased there and the mind-base will also not cease there.
Or, for whomsoever the mind-base will not cease in a certain place, had the eye-base not ceased for that person in that same place?
For those attaining final nibbāna in the five-aggregate realm, the mind-base will not cease there,
but the eye-base has not [previously] ceased for them there. For those attaining final nibbāna in the Pure Abodes,
for those attaining final nibbāna in the formless realm, and for non-percipient beings, neither the mind-base nor the eye-base has ceased there.
For whom the eye-base has not ceased at a certain place, will the mental-object-base not cease for them at that same place?

For those being reborn in the Pure Abodes, for non-percipient beings, and for those in the formless realm—the eye-base has not ceased for them there, yet it is not the case that the mental-object-base will not cease for them there. [This is so] for those attaining final Nibbāna in the Pure Abodes.
For those attaining final nibbāna in the formless realm, neither the eye-base nor the mental-object-base has ceased there.
Or, conversely, for whomsoever the mental-object-base will not cease in a certain place, has the eye-base not ceased for them there?
For those attaining final nibbāna in the five-aggregate realm, the mental-object-base will not cease there, yet it is not that the eye-base has not ceased for them there.

In that case, the eye-base had not ceased. For those attaining final nibbāna in the Pure Abodes and for those attaining final nibbāna in the formless realm, neither will the mental-object-base cease there, nor had the eye-base ceased there. (End of the section based on the eye-base.
For whom, where the nose-base had not ceased, will the visible-object-base not cease there?
For those belonging to the fine-material sphere, the nose base had not ceased there, but it is not the case that the visible-object base will not cease for them there.
For those who attain final nibbāna in the fine-material sphere and for those in the immaterial sphere,
neither the nose base nor the visible-object base has ceased, nor will the visible-object base cease, there.
Or again, for whomsoever the visible base will not cease at a certain place, has the nose base not ceased for them at that place?
For those attaining final Nibbāna in the sense-sphere realm, the visible base will not cease there, but it is not the case that the nose base has not ceased for them there.
For those attaining final Nibbāna in the fine-material sphere and for those immaterial beings, [the visible base will not cease there, and the nose base has not ceased for them there].
The visible-object base will not cease, and the nose base has not ceased.
For whomsoever the nose base has not ceased at a certain place, will the mind base not cease for them at that same place?
For those of the fine-material sphere and the immaterial sphere, the nose base has not ceased there; yet it is not the case that for them [the mind base will not cease].

In that case, the mind base will not cease. For those who attain final Nibbāna in the fine-material sphere or the immaterial sphere, and for non-percipient beings, neither the nose base nor the mind base has ceased there.
Or, conversely, for whomsoever the mind base will not cease in a certain place, has the nose base not ceased for them there?
For those attaining final nibbāna in the sense sphere, the mind base will not cease there,
but the nose base has not failed to cease there for them. For those attaining final nibbāna in the fine-material or immaterial spheres,
and for non-percipient beings, neither the mind base nor the nose base will cease there, nor has the nose base ceased there.
For whom, where the nose base (ghānāyatana) has not ceased, will the mental-object base (dhammāyatana) not cease there?

For those of the fine-material sphere (rūpāvacara) and the immaterial sphere (arūpāvacara), the nose base has not ceased there, but it is not the case that the mental-object base will not cease for them there.
[This is so] for those attaining final nibbāna (parinibbāna) in the fine-material sphere or the immaterial sphere.
In that case, there are those for whom neither the nose base has ceased nor will the mental-object base cease.
Or conversely: for whomsoever the mental-object base will not cease at a certain place, has the nose base not ceased for them at that place?
For those attaining final Nibbāna in the sense-sphere realm, the mental-object base will not cease there, yet it is not the case that the nose base has not ceased for them.

In that case, the nose base has not ceased. For those who attain final nibbāna in the fine-material sphere or the immaterial sphere, neither the mental-object base will cease nor has the nose base ceased there. (End of the section based on the nose base.
For whom, where the visible-form base has not ceased, will the mind base not cease there?
For those being reborn in the Pure Abodes and for those in the formless realm, the visible-object base has not ceased there,
yet the mind base will not fail to cease for them there. For those attaining final nibbāna in the Pure Abodes and for those attaining final nibbāna in the formless realm,
neither the visible-object base nor the mind base has ceased, nor will the mind base cease, there.
Or again, for whom the mind-base will not cease at a certain place, has the visible-form base not ceased for them there?

For those attaining final Nibbāna in the five-aggregate plane and for non-percipient beings, the mind-base will not cease there, yet the visible-form base has not failed to cease for them there. For those attaining final Nibbāna in the Pure Abodes and in the immaterial plane...
For those attaining final nibbāna there, the mind-base will not cease and the visible-form base has not ceased.
For whomsoever the visible-form base has not ceased at a certain place, will the mental-object base not cease for them there?
For those being reborn in the Pure Abodes and for those in the formless realm, the visible-form base has not ceased there; [it is] not...

And for them, the base of mental phenomena (dhammāyatana) will not cease there. For those attaining final nibbāna in the Pure Abodes (suddhāvāsa) and for those attaining final nibbāna in the formless realm (arūpa), the base of visible forms (rūpāyatana) has not ceased there, and the base of mental phenomena will not cease there either.
Or rather, for whomsoever the base of mental phenomena will not cease in a certain place, has the base of visible forms not ceased there for that person?

For those attaining final nibbāna in the five-aggregate plane, the base of mental phenomena (*dhammāyatana*) will not cease there, but the base of visible forms (*rūpāyatana*) has not failed to cease for them there.

For those attaining final nibbāna in the Pure Abodes (*suddhāvāsa*) and for those attaining final nibbāna in the formless realm (*arūpa*), neither the base of mental phenomena nor the base of visible forms will cease there, nor has the base of visible forms ceased for them there. (End of the section based on the base of visible forms.)
For whom the mind-base has not ceased at a certain place, will the mental-object-base not cease for them at that same place?

For those being reborn in the Pure Abodes and for non-percipient beings, the mind-base has not ceased there, yet the mental-object-base will not fail to cease for them there. For those attaining final Nibbāna in the Pure Abodes...
In that case, the mind-base (manāyatana) has not ceased and the mental-object-base (dhammāyatana) will not cease.
Or, for whomsoever the mental-object-base will not cease at a certain place, has the mind-base not ceased for them there?
For those who are attaining final Nibbāna (parinibbantānaṃ), the mental-object-base will not cease there, but for them the mind-base has not [previously] ceased there.
It has not ceased. For those attaining final nibbāna in the Pure Abodes, there the base of mental phenomena will not cease, and the base of mind has not ceased.
